title: CutRight v2 pack activation record (v1)
description: Persistent record of every pack activation. The activation record is content-addressed; the active_pointer file points at the hash of the latest activation record. Release builds may never repair by internet download or system package manager.

previous_activation.description: The activation_id of the previous record for this pack. The previous pack is retained for rollback.

items.description: Activation stages: staged -> verified -> written -> pointer_swapped. Rollback is a separate stage.

dev_override.description: True iff the activation was performed under a compile-time enabled development-only override. Such overrides MUST be disabled in release builds.
